duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow
duas.virtue: Protection from anxiety and sadness, bringing peace to the heart

duas.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs
duas.virtue: Strengthens trust in Allah and brings peace in difficult situations

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire
duas.virtue: Comprehensive dua for success in both worlds

dhikr.translation: Glory be to Allah and His is the praise
dhikr.benefit: Lightens the heart and brings peace and tranquility
dhikr.timing: After Fajr prayer and before sleeping

dhikr.phrase: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
dhikr.translation: There is no might nor power except with Allah
dhikr.benefit: Removes anxiety and brings peace to the heart
dhikr.timing: Throughout the day, especially in times of difficulty

dhikr.benefit: Brings relief from difficulties and opens doors of provision
dhikr.timing: After every prayer and before sleeping

scholarly_guidance.quote: The one who seeks refuge in Allah has sought refuge in an impenetrable fortress
Whoever recites Ayatul Kursi after every prayer, nothing prevents him from entering Paradise except death
The most beloved deeds to Allah are those that are consistent, even if they are small

spiritual_remedies.method: Wake up in the last third of the night, perform wudu, pray 2-8 rakats with complete focus and humility
spiritual_remedies.benefit: Strengthens connection with Allah and increases likelihood of dua acceptance

spiritual_remedies.method: Set aside time daily to recite Quran with understanding, starting with at least one page
spiritual_remedies.benefit: Brings peace to the heart and increases spiritual awareness

spiritual_remedies.method: Establish morning and evening adhkar, following the Sunnah timings and counts
spiritual_remedies.benefit: Protects from spiritual and worldly harm, brings peace and tranquility
